name: rslsp
description: Semantic Ruby/Rails language features backed by a standalone Core Language Server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Static analysis (parsing, completion, definition) works in an untrusted workspace. The Runtime Agent, which executes the workspace's own Rails/Bundler code, only starts once the workspace is trusted.

rslsp.enabled.description: Enable the RSLSP Core Language Server.

rslsp.ruby.command.description: Ruby interpreter used to launch the Core Server. Defaults to 'ruby' on PATH.

rslsp.server.path.description: Path to the rslsp Core Server entrypoint. Defaults to the bundled core/bin/rslsp script.

rslsp.observation.testCommand.description: Command used by 'RSLSP: Run Tests with Type Observation', e.g. ["bundle", "exec", "rspec"]. Defaults to the Core Server's own default (bundle exec rspec).

commands.title: RSLSP: Run Tests with Type Observation
